path=open(os.path.join(base,'start.txt')).read().strip()
chain=[]
while path!='END':
    txt=open(os.path.join(base,path)).read()
    d={}
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        k,v=line.split('=',1)
        d[k.strip()]=v.strip()
    val=int(d['value'])
    chain.append((path,val))
    nxt = d['left'] if val%2==0 else d['right']
    path=nxt
total=sum(v for _,v in chain)
with open(os.path.join(base,'chain.tsv'),'w') as f:
    for p,v in chain:
        f.write(f"{p}\t{v}\n")
    f.write(f"TOTAL\t{total}\n")
print(len(chain), total)
print(open(os.path.join(base,'chain.tsv')).read())
